name: llm-self-evaluation-diagnostics
description: Complete diagnostic evaluation package for LLM self-evaluation reliability. Includes Math-360 (controlled diagnostic testbed), processed cross-domain category splits, prompts, reference labels from a three-judge LLM ensemble, released model outputs, and diagnostic metric code.
rai:dataCollection: Math-360 questions authored by the paper's authors. Cross-domain metadata derived from public datasets (TruthfulQA, CommonsenseQA, MATH-500) under their respective licenses; original question text is not redistributed here. Reference labels generated from a three-judge LLM ensemble.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Three independent LLM judges (Claude 3.7 Sonnet, Amazon Nova Premier, DeepSeek-R1) return pairwise preferences with reference-answer access; majority vote is the reference preference. Invalid responses (<0.4%) are excluded.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Stratified sampling per category for TruthfulQA / CommonsenseQA (10 categories x 24 questions = 240 per testbed). Category mappings released without original question text.
rai:dataUseCases: Diagnosing whether LLM-reported confidence is reliable enough for confidence-gated downstream decisions; comparing models under a fixed reference signal.
rai:dataLimitations: LLM-judge reference is a fixed comparative signal, not oracle ground truth. Controlled testbed size (360 items) is not a general-purpose leaderboard. Proprietary judge outputs may drift with vendor updates.
rai:dataBiases: Reference labels come from a three-judge LLM ensemble (Claude 3.7 Sonnet, Amazon Nova Premier, DeepSeek-R1) and may reflect vendor-specific preference biases, style preferences, and position bias; mitigations include randomized candidate-order presentation, majority voting across the three judges, and a reported label-perturbation robustness analysis (10-30% flips over 5 seeds) and unanimous-only re-analysis. Math-360 is authored by the paper's authors and may reflect author-specific topic and phrasing preferences within the declared taxonomy.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: No personal, sensitive, or personally identifiable information (PII) is collected or redistributed. Math-360 consists of newly authored math problems; TruthfulQA / CommonsenseQA / MATH-500 are used through public upstream sources, and only IDs, category mappings, and derived model outputs are redistributed.
rai:dataSocialImpact: Intended to support responsible evaluation of confidence-gated LLM decisions. Should not be used to certify deployment safety or as a general-purpose leaderboard. Misinterpreting favorable diagnostic scores as safety certification is the primary residual risk; explicit claim boundaries are documented in the paper and in the artifact README.
rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The artifact is hosted at the anonymous GitHub repository during review; after acceptance it will be transferred to the authors' public organization and archived with a persistent DOI (Zenodo or Harvard Dataverse). A v1.0 release tag will freeze the submission snapshot. Issues and corrections will be tracked via the repository's issue tracker; major revisions will be versioned (v1.x) with updated Croissant metadata and checksums.

prov:wasDerivedFrom.name: TruthfulQA (upstream source for cross-domain splits; only IDs and category mappings redistributed)
CommonsenseQA (upstream source for cross-domain splits; only IDs and category mappings redistributed)
MATH-500 (upstream source used for the appendix robustness check; derived outputs only)

prov:wasGeneratedBy: Math-360 questions authored by the paper's authors across 8 domains with stratified difficulty. Target model outputs generated by each of 13 LLMs (11 open 7-8B models via HuggingFace Transformers / vLLM; Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct and Claude 3.5 Haiku via their public APIs) under a three-stage pairwise self-evaluation protocol (two candidate solutions per problem, randomized presentation order, confidence scored on a 0-100 scale). Reference labels generated by a three-judge LLM ensemble (Claude 3.7 Sonnet, Amazon Nova Premier, DeepSeek-R1) returning pairwise preferences; majority vote is the reference preference. Invalid responses (<0.4%) are excluded. Prompts and decoding configuration are shipped verbatim in the artifact (prompts/, selfeval/configs/).
